parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment mentions "the proposed grid flow representation," which identifies the topic of the comment but does not pinpoint a specific section, table, figure, or precisely locatable part of the paper. Under the rubric, full grounding requires explicitly identifying such a specific location; since the comment only names a method concept without indicating where it is discussed, the authors cannot confidently determine which part of the paper is being addressed. On the other hand, the comment is specific about what needs to be addressed: it asks that the differences and limitations relative to the classical mesh flow (MeshFlow: Minimum Latency Online Video Stabilization) be clarified in the context of homography estimation, providing clear direction for revision. Thus, while the specificity condition is well satisfied, the grounding does not meet the threshold for a fully grounded comment, as the authors cannot confidently locate the referenced part.
